name: Stop 4 Nails
story: Stop 4 Nails is a neighborhood nail salon in Renton’s East Valley Business Park at 212 SW 43rd Street. Open seven days—weekdays and Saturdays 10 to 7, Sundays 10 to 5—with walk-ins welcome when they can fit you in. Menu covers manicures and pedicures (classic to spa), lashes, waxing, and full-set work with shellac and gel options. Book online or call (425) 254-3554. Follow @stop4nailsrenton on Instagram.

reviews.text: I stopped by Stop 4 Nails as a walk-in… They welcomed me in and were able to get me in quickly.
reviews.author: Inna M.

reviews.text: They have always done a great job on my nails (acrylic with gel polish)… Prices are fair.

reviews.text: They do a very good pedicure here… We come with my wife together, always.
